## Purpose
Give brief, actionable guidance so an AI coding agent can make safe, minimal, and correct edits to this Flutter + Firebase app.

## Big picture (what this repo is)
- Project: `chat_app` — a Flutter mobile/web/desktop app using Firebase backend.
- Entry point: `lib/main.dart` — initializes Firebase (uses `lib/firebase_options.dart`) and launches `AuthGate`.
- Auth flow: `lib/auth/auth_gate.dart` listens to `FirebaseAuth.instance.authStateChanges()` and routes to `lib/pages/home_page.dart` when signed in or `lib/auth/log_or_register.dart` when not.
- Auth API: `lib/auth/auth_service.dart` provides `signInEP`, `registerEP`, and `signOut` wrappers around `FirebaseAuth`.
- UI: pages live in `lib/pages/` (`login_page.dart`, `register_page.dart`, `home_page.dart`). Reusable widgets in `lib/components/` (`my_button.dart`, `my_textfield.dart`). Theme in `lib/themes/light_modes.dart`.
- Assets: `assets/images/` (logo files). Android Firebase config is in `android/app/google-services.json`. iOS/macOS settings under `ios/`.

## Key integration points
- Firebase packages are declared in `pubspec.yaml`: `firebase_core`, `firebase_auth`, `cloud_firestore`, `firebase_storage`. Check `lib/firebase_options.dart` (generated by FlutterFire CLI) for platform API keys and project IDs.
- Auth state controls navigation: avoid duplicating navigation logic — use `AuthGate` stream when adding features that depend on authentication.
- `AuthService` is the single place to change authentication behavior (error handling, logging, or new providers).

## Project-specific conventions & patterns
- Folder layout: keep pages in `lib/pages/`, small reusable UI in `lib/components/`, and feature logic in `lib/auth/`.
- Widgets are mostly StatelessWidgets; pages hold `TextEditingController` fields directly (see `login_page.dart` and `register_page.dart`). When adding stateful logic, prefer a local `State` object or small provider rather than global singletons.
- UI components use theme colors from `lib/themes/light_modes.dart`. Use `Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary` for primary actions (e.g., `MyButton`).
- Forms: textual validation is performed in-page (e.g., password mismatch in `register_page.dart`) and errors are displayed via `AlertDialog`—follow this pattern for consistency.

## Build / run / test (developer workflows)
Use the Flutter toolchain. Typical commands to run locally:

```powershell
# install deps
flutter pub get

# run on the default device/emulator
flutter run

# run tests
flutter test

# build Android APK
flutter build apk --release
```

Notes:
- Android requires a valid Android SDK path in `local.properties` (typical Flutter Android setup). `android/app/google-services.json` is already present; do not overwrite unless reconfiguring Firebase.
- If you need to re-run Firebase setup, use the FlutterFire CLI to regenerate `lib/firebase_options.dart` and follow up with `flutter pub get`.

## Safe edit rules for AI agents (concrete)
1. Do not remove or reformat `lib/firebase_options.dart` unless regenerating via FlutterFire CLI — it is referenced directly from `main.dart`.
2. When modifying auth flows, update `lib/auth/auth_service.dart` and keep `AuthGate` as the single source of truth for signed-in state.
3. Keep UI changes localized to `lib/pages/` and `lib/components/`. If adding new components, place them in `lib/components/` and update imports accordingly.
4. Avoid changing dependency versions in `pubspec.yaml` without running `flutter pub get` and smoke-testing the app; prefer separate PRs for dependency bumps.
5. Preserve the existing error-handling pattern: show a user-facing `AlertDialog` on auth failures (see `login_page.dart` / `register_page.dart`).

## Examples (quick patterns)
- Add a new auth method: extend `AuthService` with a method `Future<UserCredential> signInWithGoogle()` then call it from a page; do not bypass `AuthGate` for navigation.
- To style a new primary button, mirror `MyButton` and use `Theme.of(context).colorScheme.primary` for background color.

## Files to inspect when making changes
- `lib/main.dart` — app entry and Firebase init
- `lib/firebase_options.dart` — Firebase platform options (generated)
- `lib/auth/auth_gate.dart` — central auth-based routing
- `lib/auth/auth_service.dart` — authentication helper methods
- `lib/pages/*` and `lib/components/*` — UI locations to modify
- `pubspec.yaml` — dependencies and assets

## Verification checklist (before PR)
- Run `flutter analyze` / `flutter test` and fix obvious lint/test failures.
- Run the app on an emulator and ensure auth flow still navigates (start at `AuthGate`).
- Confirm no new secrets are added to commits (avoid adding private keys or service files).

## If something's unclear or missing
Mention which platform you will run on (android/ios/web). If modifying Firebase integration, note whether you'll update `android/app/google-services.json` and `lib/firebase_options.dart` together. Ask the repo maintainer if you need to change published dependency versions.
